source_title: Infosys sets up new 1.1M sq ft block at Pocharam campus in Hyderabad to cater to emerging technologies - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Hyderabad: IT services giant Infosys has set up a new 1.1 million sq ft software development block at its Pocharam campus to add capabilities in AI, cloud, cybersecurity, engineering and next-generation digital services, marking an expansion of its presence in Telangana.The new facility, inaugurated on Friday, is expected to add capacity for another 10,000 seats and accommodate an additional workforce of more than 13,000 employees under a hybrid working model. The Pocharam campus, spread across 450 acres, currently has seven software development blocks with about 4.58 million sq ft of built-up area.Infosys said the Pocharam Development Center supports global clients across banking, financial services and insurance, retail, life sciences and manufacturing.The expanded facility is designed to strengthen delivery capabilities in advanced technology areas as enterprises increase investments in digital transformation and AI-led services.Inaugurating the new block, Telangana deputy chief minister Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka said: âTelangana has established itself as a global technology destination, supported by world-class infrastructure, skilled talent and a thriving innovation ecosystem.
